turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Gupta from Hyderabad?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Gupta speaking. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Ananya from the State Bank fraud prevention cell, calling to confirm a transaction of fifty thousand rupees made this morning.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Fifty thousand? I did not make any such payment today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is exactly why I am calling. We noticed a suspicious attempt and have temporarily blocked the transfer for your safety.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh my goodness, thank you. What do I need to do now to fix this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You do not need to do anything on this call. Please just visit your home branch in person tomorrow with your ID to resolve it.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Can you not just take my details over the phone to verify it now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, Mr. Gupta, we will never ask for your OTP, PIN, or account details over the phone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I see. I was worried someone would ask me for a code or something.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Exactly, please remember that bank officials never ask for such private information. Just go to the branch and they will help you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Alright, I will go there tomorrow morning. Thank you for the warning.
